title: Lease: Retrieving lease info using lease client LeaseTimeToLive() causes etcd node panic and die
body:
I observe that when lease client is retrieving a lease using LeaseTimeToLive() at the moment after the lease just has expired causes one of three etcd nodes to panic and die.

Setup:
OS: OS X El Captitan 10.11.6
etcd Version: 3.1.0-alpha.0+gi
Go Version: go1.7
Go OS/Arch: darwin/amd64

Recreating the issue:
1. Download ectd code in your working directory.
2. CD into `../github.com/coreos/etcd`, start a three node etcd quorum via `goreman start` 
3. In a different terminal, run following script 

``` go
package main
import (
    "fmt"
    pb "github.com/coreos/etcd/etcdserver/etcdserverpb"
    "golang.org/x/net/context"
    "google.golang.org/grpc"
)

func main() {
    p := fmt.Println
    conn, err := grpc.Dial("localhost:2379", grpc.WithInsecure())
    if err != nil {
        p(err)
    }
    lc := pb.NewLeaseClient(conn)
    ctx, _ := context.WithCancel(context.Background())

    resp, err := lc.LeaseGrant(ctx, &pb.LeaseGrantRequest{
        TTL: 2,
    }, grpc.FailFast(false))

    LTL := &pb.LeaseTimeToLiveRequest{
        ID:   resp.ID,
        Keys: true,
    }

    for {
        leaseTTLResp, err := lc.LeaseTimeToLive(ctx, LTL)
        if err != nil {
            p(err)
        }
        p(leaseTTLResp)
    }
}
```
